title: Whole-plan `sqitch verify` divides by zero on a fully deployed DB
repro: podman run -d --name pg --platform linux/amd64 -e POSTGRES_USER=sig -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=sig -e POSTGRES_DB=sig docker.io/postgis/postgis:18-3.6; SQ='podman run --rm --network container:pg -v $PWD/db:/repo:ro -w /repo docker.io/sqitch/sqitch:latest'; $SQ deploy db:pg://sig:sig@127.0.0.1:5432/sig; $SQ verify db:pg://sig:sig@127.0.0.1:5432/sig -> 'psql:verify/shared_temporal_contract.sql:30: ERROR: division by zero', 'Changes: 48 Errors: 1', rc 2 (F5 reproduced 2026-09-30T17:38:12Z; spine_watermark count(*) = 28)
root_cause: verify/shared_temporal_contract.sql:30 asserts the GLOBAL facet count (count(*) FROM spine_watermark = 27); publication_dispositions (the next plan line, P32.5) legitimately adds a 28th facet (publication_disposition). The verify pins an open-ended shared registry instead of the facets this change installs. make check / make test-db only deploy, so nothing ever ran a whole-plan verify.
fix_shape: Append-only sqitch rework (verified in F5 exp3): `sqitch tag <r11-tag>` then `sqitch rework shared_temporal_contract`; the landed scripts are preserved byte-identical as `*@<r11-tag>.sql`; the reworked deploy/revert are no-ops; the reworked verify asserts the 27 named facets this change installs (plus the unchanged per-facet invariants). sqitch v1.6.1 skips the earlier instance's verify (proved with a poisoned @tag copy), so whole-plan verify exits 0; full deploy->verify->revert->deploy->verify round trip green. Record the verify-contract rule in an ADR. No edit to any landed plan line or deploy/revert script. Note: a rework cannot change what the landed L44/L46 deploy scripts do on a DB that has not deployed them yet, so the hosted lock/rewrite hazard of L44/L46 (G2 NEW-3) stays a G2 rehearsal item.
risk_if_unfixed: Whole-plan verify stays red; any hosted L44-52 deploy followed by `sqitch verify` fails; the defect class recurs silently because no gate runs verify.

title: Whole-plan `sqitch revert` fails at revert/extensions.sql (postgis has dependents)
repro: podman run -d --name pg --platform linux/amd64 -e POSTGRES_USER=sig -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=sig -e POSTGRES_DB=sig docker.io/postgis/postgis:18-3.6; SQ='podman run --rm --network container:pg -v $PWD/db:/repo:ro -w /repo docker.io/sqitch/sqitch:latest'; $SQ deploy db:pg://sig:sig@127.0.0.1:5432/sig; $SQ revert -y db:pg://sig:sig@127.0.0.1:5432/sig -> 'extension postgis_topology depends on extension postgis / extension postgis_tiger_geocoder depends on extension postgis', rc 2 (F5 2026-09-30T17:38:18Z). Control: same plan into `CREATE DATABASE x TEMPLATE template0` -> deploy, full revert ('No changes deployed'), redeploy all exit 0 (F5 exp2 17:43:22Z)
root_cause: The postgis/postgis image's initdb script pre-creates postgis, postgis_topology, postgis_tiger_geocoder and fuzzystrmatch in POSTGRES_DB (seen before deploy: 'fuzzystrmatch, plpgsql, postgis, postgis_tiger_geocoder, postgis_topology'). deploy/extensions.sql:12 `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis` is therefore a no-op there, and revert/extensions.sql:7 drops an extension the plan never created and that has image-created dependents. In a DB where the plan owns its extensions the unmodified plan round-trips.
fix_shape: Recommended (no migration change): tests/db/conftest.py and the new CI round-trip job deploy into a database created FROM template0, so the test extension set equals what the plan owns (no SQL depends on fuzzystrmatch/topology/tiger: grep). ADR states 'the plan owns only the extensions it creates'. Optional append-only alternative (verified F5 exp2 E-B2): a new last change `extension_dependents_teardown` [extensions] whose deploy is a no-op and whose revert drops postgis_tiger_geocoder/postgis_topology IF EXISTS. Rejected: CASCADE or ordered drops in revert/extensions.sql (in-place edit of a landed revert; CASCADE silently drops dependents).
risk_if_unfixed: No reversible-migration evidence for the spine; tests run against an extension set production never had (inference for Cloud SQL: its extension list was not read, P3).

title: Full `sqitch revert` fails when a second database in the same cluster carries the plan (cluster-global roles)
source_refs: F5 NEW-4; G1 NEW-14 (same-instance restore drill)
component: db (revert scripts that DROP ROLE: recovery_apply, intake_*, materialize_role, access_control, human_eval_campaign)
repro: In one PG18 cluster: deploy the plan into two databases (e.g. two `CREATE DATABASE … TEMPLATE template_postgis`), then `sqitch revert -y` one of them -> 'psql:revert/recovery_apply.sql:22: ERROR: role "sig_recovery" cannot be dropped because some objects depend on it / DETAIL: 23 objects in database e_a1' (F5 exp 2026-09-30T17:40:15Z).
root_cause: Deploy scripts create cluster-global roles idempotently (NOTICE 'already been granted membership'), but revert scripts DROP ROLE unconditionally; a role granted objects in another database cannot be dropped. If same-instance restore drills are adopted (G1), use a separate instance or accept revert-unavailability there. Optional later: a new change that moves role teardown behind an 'no other database references the role' guard (DO block on pg_shdepend) — append-only, only if a real need appears.
risk_if_unfixed: A restore drill or staging DB on the production instance cannot be reverted with sqitch; operators may reach for manual DROP … CASCADE.
